scripts:
set properties on /content/dam/supporttickets/jcr:content
  set cq:conf{String} to /conf/supporttickets
  set jcr:title{String} to "Support Ticket Management"
end

set properties on /home/users/support/agent1/profile
  set givenName{String} to "Alex"
  set familyName{String} to "Agent"
  set email{String} to "agent1@example.com"
  set role{String} to "AGENT"
end

set properties on /home/users/support/agent2/profile
  set givenName{String} to "Sam"
  set familyName{String} to "Agent"
  set email{String} to "agent2@example.com"
  set role{String} to "AGENT"
end

set properties on /home/users/support/supervisor1/profile
  set givenName{String} to "Pat"
  set familyName{String} to "Supervisor"
  set email{String} to "supervisor1@example.com"
  set role{String} to "SUPERVISOR"
end

set ACL on /content/support-tickets
  allow jcr:read,rep:write,crx:replicate for support-tickets-service
end

set ACL on /home/users
  allow jcr:read for support-tickets-service
end

set ACL on /home/users/support
  allow jcr:read for support-tickets-service
end
